examples.translation: For this is what Jehovah of armies says, who after being glorified has sent me to the nations that were plundering you: ‘Whoever touches you touches the pupil of my eye.'

examples.english: So he can say to you with pride: "my beloved small one, you are the apple of my eyes. I love you even with your temper. I provide for you, care for you and comfort you."

examples.text: Y que él con orgullo pueda decirte: "mi amada pequeñita, tu eres la nina de mis ojos. Yo te amo aún con tus enojos. Te proveo, te cuido y te consuelo."
examples.translation: So he can say to you with pride: "my beloved small one, you are the apple of my eyes. I love you even with your temper. I provide for you, care for you and comfort you."

examples.english: Never doubt it, you are the apple of my eyes.
examples.text: Nunca lo dudes, tu eres la niña de mis ojos.
examples.translation: Never doubt it, you are the apple of my eyes.
